1.consolidated_definition: Jabón líquido para lavar el cabello. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. DRAE 2001, del inglés. Instrucciones detalladas sobre qué tipos de champú y desodorantes pueden pasar se intercambian continuamente en las filas de visitantes
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Liquid shampoo for washing hair. Adapted Anglicism, commonly used. Derived from English, as per DRAE 2001.

Instructions:
- Wash your hair with liquid shampoo.
- Detailed instructions on which types of shampoo and deodorants can be exchanged are continuously displayed in the visitor lines.
